records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Your workspace for Clearwater Dynamics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero engagement: no first project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to the onboarding email [email:3413621d]. Only outbound Wrenfield contact exists; no customer signal of intent. Silent accounts this far into the window rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though the active Pro subscription leaves some chance.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Following up on my note from last week — I know launch weeks get busy at Clearwater Dynamics.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is what makes the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you live, or answer anything over email.

Best,
Nadia
